title: Implement Operator Token Authentication
description: Implement operator (human) authentication using token-based auth (JWT or simple bearer tokens). Operators authenticate via the REST API to perform dashboard actions. Implement token generation on login, token validation on each request, token expiry, and token refresh. Operator records are stored in the operators table from FORGEOS-BE002.
acceptance_criteria: Token generation endpoint (POST /api/auth/login) accepts operator credentials and returns a bearer token
Token validation extracts operator identity from the bearer token on each REST request
Tokens include operator_id, name, role, and expiry timestamp
Token refresh endpoint extends the session without re-authentication
Operator credentials stored as bcrypt hashes in the operators table
